original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. armada-nitro's committed-gate command (gate.command in .exophial/config.yaml) runs an npm install (npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --offline, matching armada-poc's gate) before pre-commit run --all-files. The ephemeral committed-gate worktree then has node_modules, so a branch that adds or edits a .ts file runs eslint and prettier in the gate instead of failing.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. gate.command in armada-nitro/.exophial/config.yaml is only ['pre-commit', 'run', '--all-files'] with no npm install. The ephemeral gate worktree has no node_modules, so a branch that adds or edits a .ts file fails eslint with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND 'typescript-eslint' and prettier cannot run. TS chunks only merge on the worker path, where the worker's own npm ci populates node_modules.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. gate.command in armada-nitro/.exophial/config.yaml runs npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --offline before pre-commit run --all-files. In a fresh worktree with no node_modules, running the gate command populates node_modules and then runs pre-commit; eslint and prettier run on a .ts file with no ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
restatement: The committed-gate command for armada-nitro, set as gate.command in .exophial/config.yaml, must install the Node packages before it runs the pre-commit hooks. It must run 'npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --offline', the same install armada-poc's gate uses. It must then run 'pre-commit run --all-files'. A fresh gate worktree then has node_modules. A branch that adds or edits a .ts file then gets real eslint and prettier checks, not an ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND failure for 'typescript-eslint'.
